name: CUSTOM CUSTOMS INC.
old_description: With each entrusted client, Nick and the staff, here at Custom Customs Inc, makes sure every aspect of your work and experience is flawless. Using the same system as the coroners office, your job is carefully examined from the beginning of your estimate, to fabrication, to powder coat, and finally installation.
about:
Custom Customs Inc. is based in Henderson, Nevada. Founded in 2018 by Nick Baumert, the company began in his garage with $12 and a dream. Baumert, a former union ironworker and Clark County coroner's office funeral director, started the business as a single father without loans or outside partners.

The shop produces custom metalwork including security doors, pedestrian gates, RV gates, community and commercial entrance gates, CNC-cut décor and monogram signs, and security door inlays. Services also cover 24/7 emergency mobile welding and repair, with all pieces moving through an in-house process of estimation, fabrication, powder coating, and installation.

Customers range from homeowners seeking residential security and decorative ironwork to commercial clients needing community entrance gates and custom fabrication. The company serves the greater Las Vegas area.

Baumert's background in the coroner's office shaped a quality-control system that tracks each job from estimate through final installation, aiming to leave no step missed. The firm emphasizes a customer-first philosophy rooted in the belief that every problem has a solution.
